problem: Companion performance measurements and evaluator existed, but release checks did not have a product entrypoint that composes the current N.E.K.O launcher generation, existing live soak/startup reconcile, and native cold-start benchmark into one fail-closed verdict.

reuse_search.L0: N.E.K.O remains lifecycle/port authority; XiaoYu owns only Companion acceptance budgets.
reuse_search.L1: Current pin ready runtime record already publishes final MAIN/MEMORY/TOOL ports plus USER_PLUGIN internal port.
reuse_search.L2: Latest upstream d90f837 keeps the same authoritative ready-record model; no native Companion-wide budget orchestrator replaces XiaoYu acceptance.
reuse_search.L3: Existing XiaoYu live soak, reconcile and performance evaluator are reused instead of replaced.
reuse_search.L4: PowerShell/Python stdlib composition is sufficient; external monitoring/benchmark frameworks would duplicate existing authorities.
reuse_search.L5: Selected thin orchestration: choose live or cold_start source profile, reject stale launcher generation/reconcile, then call the existing evaluator.
reuse_search.L6: No private runtime, transport, sampler, supervisor or cache is added.

live.basis: Existing XiaoYu event-loop evidence classifies >1s synchronous stalls as user-visible regressions; local health surfaces crossing 1s p95 are therefore blocked.
live.reconcile_basis: Matches the existing XiaoYu startup readiness/reconcile outer ceiling; current-generation matching prevents stale PASS reuse.
live.process_count_basis: A live Companion release requires one desktop shell and one N.E.K.O backend owner; zero is missing runtime, more than one is churn/duplicate ownership.

cold_start.basis: Uses N.E.K.O's native default server-ready timeout as the cold-start performance boundary rather than XiaoYu's longer recovery ceiling.

acceptance: live profile derives all four service URLs from the current ready N.E.K.O launcher record
live profile rejects stale or generation-less plugin reconcile evidence
live profile reuses the existing read-only soak and evaluator without adding a request implementation
cold_start profile requires and consumes N.E.K.O native runtime_memory_baseline JSON
run_checks.ps1 exposes an explicit CompanionPerformance release mode without changing startup preflight
ordinary agent pushes run orchestrator contract tests
no subprocess/psutil/urllib/httpx/requests authority is introduced by the orchestrator
live profile fails when desktop/backend process observation is zero instead of treating zero as under the maximum
retirement_condition: Retire the orchestration layer when N.E.K.O publishes an equivalent generation-bound live/cold performance verdict that XiaoYu release acceptance can consume directly.
